Five Nights At Freddy's: THE FLIPSIDE RPG

A downloadable game for Windows

Five Nights At Freddy's: THE FLIPSIDE

After the events of Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, the souls of the missing children are lost in limbo, and to find their way out they must confront and unravel the true nature of the flipside.

DEMO 1 IS OUT NOW.

This is a FNAF fan-game that is inspired by RPGs such as Undertale, Deltarune, Earthbound, OFF and FNAF world.


CONTROLS:

ARROW KEYS  : MOVE

Z/ENTER     : CONFIRM

X/SHIFT     : CANCEL

C/CONTROL   : MENU

F11         : FULLSCREEN

NUMBERS 1-4 : CHANGE WINDOWED MODE PIXEL SIZE

+ KEY       : INCREASE MASTER VOLUME

- KEY       : LOWER MASTER VOLUME

HOLD ESC    : QUIT

rubberfruit17 days ago(+1)

WOW! Absolutely outstanding work. I will be recommending this to everyone who has even a passing interest in FNAF/Toby Fox's games. An incredible length for a demo, incredible music, incredible atmosphere, incredible writing. A marriage made in a plutonian pizza parlor. Really just a class act all around.

If I had ONE (1) critique, it would be that I'm not really sure which attacks do and do not grant TP. There are some attacks that grant me upwards of 30 TP, and there are some that leave me confused as to whether or not the bullets are grazable. I should add that this did not take away from my overall enjoyment of the game, but it did make the strategy between each fight feel at times a touch incoherent. 

Either way, bravo, bravo and bravo a third time. I will be following this game and everything involved with great interest.

I'm not someone who's into FNAF but I found out about this by chance and it's seriously already something special. Very well done atmosphere, great writing, the NPC dialogue was enjoyable, and the battle system may be one of my favourite in any RPG I've played. Attacking is very satisfying and the bullet patterns were harder than I expected for a demo (this is a good thing!).

Only real criticism I can think of from my playthrough is the backgrounds in battles are very cool, though I found them slightly disorienting as someone with vision problems. A way to tone down the animations would be very welcome.

Very good fangame, I'll be following it closely. It may have gotten me into FNAF :)
